fix_and_optimize.prompt: Optimize - use single auxiliary array (in-place merge):
fix_and_optimize.answer:
def merge_sort(arr):
    aux = arr.copy()
    def _merge_sort(arr, aux, low, high):
        if high - low <= 1:
            return
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        _merge_sort(aux, arr, low, mid)
        _merge_sort(aux, arr, mid, high)
        # Merge from aux back to arr
        i, j, k = low, mid, low
        while i < mid and j < high:
            if aux[i] <= aux[j]:
                arr[k] = aux[i]
                i += 1
            else:
                arr[k] = aux[j]
                j += 1
            k += 1
        while i < mid:
            arr[k] = aux[i]
            i += 1
            k += 1
        while j < high:
            arr[k] = aux[j]
            j += 1
            k += 1
    _merge_sort(arr, aux, 0, len(arr))
fix_and_optimize.explanation: Alternating arrays avoids repeated allocation. O(n) space total.
